name: NG exhaustion chain Phase-2 P-O-X branch reconciliation v2

disposition.rule: A failed fold or losing instance is preserved and decomposed. It is not deleted merely because it conflicts with an aggregate candidate mean.

predeclared_current_vs_latest_polarity_b.note: Current-vs-latest predecessor polarity relation was already permitted in the original Phase-2 candidate family and is known at current t0.

x_to_opposite_current.interpretation: This branch remains positive in gross mean in discovery, replication, untouched confirmation, and held insertion. The held sample is small and the exact held shift alone is not promotion-grade, so the branch is prioritized but not frozen.

x_to_same_current.interpretation: The held reversal is concentrated here, but the branch was positive in every pre-held aggregate block. It remains active and must not be erased.

held_branch_difference_exact_label_permu.interpretation: Within the held week, the polarity-resolution fork is structured rather than a uniform P-O-X failure. This is forensic evidence, not a held-selected promotion rule.

held_path_from_entry_plus5.interpretation: The held same-polarity branch is a timing/state-transition anomaly: adverse expression develops after +10, is worst around +60, then the aggregate turns positive again by +300. The branch is not accurately described as simply absent.

same_branch_delayed_reexpression.interpretation: Exploratory only: held same-branch losses were unusually likely to recover to nonnegative by +300 versus prior negative-at-60 same-branch cases. This supports a delayed/re-origin interpretation but is not a new trade rule.

successor_reorigin.reason: Historically, successor-before-exit cases can still be positive; successor onset and polarity interact with the branch. A successor is better treated as an observable state transition once it occurs, not leaked into original entry selection.

absolute_polarity_exploration.interpretation: The DOWN same-polarity branch was already weakening before the held week, while the DOWN opposite-polarity branch stayed positive. Because absolute-polarity subdivision was not the predeclared branch used for the original candidate disposition, this is a hypothesis for future OOT validation, not a frozen rule.

preentry_discriminator_search.method: Exploratory univariate threshold scan on causal-at-entry current timing/detector fields plus fully available predecessor timing, flow, book, prominence, and post-end history. Thresholds were chosen only from Eras 1-3 quantiles and inspected on Eras 4-5, untouched confirmation, then held.
preentry_discriminator_search.interpretation: There is no defensible simple pre-entry carve-out that labels the held same-branch losses invalid. The losing instances must remain in the evidence.

next_research_contract.priority_candidate: P,O,X plus current polarity opposite latest X polarity
next_research_contract.same_branch_task: Model short adverse phase versus delayed/re-origin expression without using held-selected exclusions.
next_research_contract.successor_task: Treat each observed successor exhaustion as a new causal state-transition checkpoint and test reset/continue/reverse semantics prospectively.
next_research_contract.promotion_boundary: No P-O-X branch is promoted into the frozen paper-play set from this forensic pass alone.
